title: 5 Things You’re Doing That Look Right But Aren’t
paragraphs: 5 Things You’re Doing That Look Right But Aren’t
There are sins people cry over.
And then there are sins people clap for.
That second kind is the most dangerous.
Because the devil rarely walks into a believer’s life holding obvious darkness anymore. He walks in dressed like wisdom. Like maturity. Like self-care. Like balance. Like success. Like “peace.”
And some of the most spiritually dead people on earth still go to church every Sunday.
Still lift their hands during worship.
Meanwhile heaven is grieving over the version of Christianity we normalized.
This is not written to shame you.
This is written because eternity is too real to keep pretending.
Jesus never warned believers about obvious wolves first.
The kind that slowly hardens the soul while convincing you you’re spiritually healthy.
And maybe that’s why this hurts.
you already know some of this is about you.
This hit harder than you expected.
Send this to someone who loves Jesus but has been slowly compromising without realizing it.
Because some people are not far from God because they hate Him.
They are far from Him because they slowly replaced obedience with appearances.
The apostle Paul warned Timothy that in the last days people would have “a form of godliness” while denying its power.
The Greek phrase used in 2 Timothy 3:5 is:
It literally describes an outward shape or appearance of godliness without authentic transformation.
Here are 5 things many believers are doing right now that look righteous…
The first one already exposed thousands.
1. You’re Protecting Your Peace More Than You’re Carrying Your Cross
This generation worships comfort and calls it healing.
And while boundaries can absolutely be biblical…
many believers now use “peace” as an excuse for disobedience.
“If anyone would come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.”
The Greek phrase for “deny himself” is:
It means to utterly disown self-interest.
Modern Christianity often teaches people how to feel better.
Biblical Christianity teaches people how to die to themselves.
That’s why many believers panic anytime obedience becomes uncomfortable.
So people leave churches the moment conviction arrives.
They abandon assignments the moment pressure appears.
They isolate from accountability while calling it “protecting their peace.”
But biblical peace was never the absence of difficulty.
It was the presence of Christ in difficulty.
The Hebrew word for peace is:
And it means far more than emotional calm.
You can have worldly comfort and still lack shalom.
And some believers are protecting comfort while losing spiritual authority.
That’s why your spirit has felt dry lately.
2. You’re Calling Conviction “Judgment” So You Never Have To Change
One of the enemy’s greatest modern strategies is convincing people that correction is hate.
Now anytime Scripture confronts sin, people say:
But that sentence is usually not humility.
The Bible absolutely condemns hypocritical judgment.
But it never condemns righteous discernment.
In fact, Jesus said in John 7:24:
“Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
It literally means to discern rightly according to truth.
Biblical love does not celebrate sin to avoid uncomfortable conversations.
Biblical love pulls people away from destruction.
A doctor who sees cancer but refuses to speak is not loving.
And churches that never confront sin create spiritually dying people who still think they are healthy.
That’s why some believers only follow preachers who never challenge them.
Messages become motivational instead of transformational.
But grace was never permission to remain chained.
The apostle Paul asked in Romans 6:1:
“Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound?”
The Greek phrase there is incredibly strong:
And some of you already know the Holy Spirit has been trying to confront something you keep defending.
God is not exposing you to destroy you.
He is exposing what is destroying you.
3. You’re Consuming Christian Content More Than You’re Actually Obeying God
Because many believers feel spiritually full while remaining spiritually inactive.
But still do not obey what God already told them.
Knowledge can create the illusion of intimacy with God.
But information alone never transforms the soul.
“Be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.”
The Greek word for “deceiving” in James 1:22 is:
To convince yourself you are spiritually healthy while remaining unchanged.
Because you can know Scripture intellectually while your heart slowly drifts from God.
Even demons know who Jesus is.
Many people today have substituted consumption for discipleship.
They emotionally react to truth without actually applying truth.
And emotional agreement is not obedience.
Tears during worship are not always surrender.
Posting conviction online is not the same as living convicted privately.
The Pharisees knew Scripture better than almost anyone.
Yet they crucified the Messiah standing in front of them.
Knowledge without humility becomes spiritual pride.
And spiritual pride is one of the hardest sins to detect because it often wears religious clothing.
This is why Jesus constantly emphasized fruit.
And maybe the Holy Spirit is asking you something uncomfortable right now:
When was the last time you obeyed something difficult God told you?
4. You’re Confusing Busy Ministry With Genuine Intimacy With God
Some people are active in church…
But secretly feel distant from God.
Because activity for God is not the same as intimacy with God.
One of the most terrifying passages in Scripture is Matthew 7:22-23.

“Many will say to Me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, cast out demons in Your name, and do many mighty works in Your name?’ And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you.’”
That means it is possible to publicly represent Jesus while privately neglecting Him.
People applaud your gift while your soul quietly starves.
This is happening to more believers than people realize.
Because modern Christianity often rewards visibility more than holiness.
Followers become more important than fruit.
Platforms become more important than prayer.
Influence becomes more important than integrity.
And people slowly start using God to build themselves instead of surrendering themselves to God.
But Jesus never died to create celebrities.
Because eventually public ministry can only sustain what private intimacy produced.
And if the secret place dies…
Some of you do not need another opportunity.
You need another encounter with God.
5. You’re Loving The Blessings Of God More Than God Himself
This may be the deepest wound in the modern church.
And you can tell because many believers only seek Him intensely during emergencies.
If life goes well, God is praised.
But genuine love for God survives both abundance and suffering.
“Though He slay me, yet will I trust Him.”
In Hebrew thought, covenant was never casual.
The Hebrew word often connected to covenant love is:
This word carries the idea of faithful, loyal, covenant love.
And many believers are emotionally attached to what God gives…
while remaining spiritually distant from who He is.
That is why suffering exposes so much.
Because trials reveal whether we loved God…
or simply loved the life we hoped He would give us.
Some people walk away from God the moment prayers are unanswered because they built their faith around outcomes instead of Christ.
Even if I do not understand Him…
And maybe that’s the question underneath this entire article.
If God removed every blessing tomorrow…
Because eternity is not built on emotional moments.
And the scariest deception is not open rebellion.
It is looking spiritually alive while slowly drifting from the heart of God.
But here is the beautiful part.
Jesus still restores people who wandered.
This article is not a declaration of condemnation.
Because the cross was never about making bad people look good.
It was about making dead people alive.
And maybe tonight the Holy Spirit exposed something because He still loves you enough not to leave you numb.
One day many people will discover they were close to church…
5 Bagay Na Ginagawa Mo Na Mukhang Tama Pero Mali Pala
May mga kasalanang iniiyakan ng tao.
At mayroon ding mga kasalanang pinapalakpakan pa.
Dahil bihira nang lumapit ang diyablo na halatang madilim.
At nakakatakot isipin na maraming espirituwal na tuyong tao ang nasa simbahan pa rin tuwing Linggo.
Nagpo-post pa rin ng Bible verse.
Nakataas pa rin ang kamay sa worship.
“Alam naman ng Diyos ang puso ko.”
Habang tahimik na nasasaktan ang langit sa klaseng Christianity na ginawa nating normal.
Hindi ito isinulat para husgahan ka.
Isinulat ito dahil totoong may impiyerno.
At masyadong mahalaga ang kaluluwa mo para magpanggap lang.
Hindi unang binalaan ni Jesus ang tao tungkol sa halatang kasamaan.
Binalaan Niya tayo tungkol sa panlilinlang.
Yung dahan-dahang nagpapatigas ng puso habang pinapaniwala kang “okay ka naman spiritually.”
kasi alam mong may parte rito na tungkol sa’yo.
Mas tumama ito kaysa inaasahan mo.
Dahil maraming tao ang hindi lumalayo sa Diyos dahil galit sila sa Kanya.
Lumayo sila dahil pinalitan nila ang obedience ng appearance.
At kayang lokohin ng appearance ang tao.
Pero hindi nito kayang lokohin ang Diyos.
Sinabi ni apostle Paul sa 2 Timothy 3:5 na magkakaroon ng mga taong may “anyo ng kabanalan” pero wala namang kapangyarihan nito.
Pero walang tunay na pagbabago sa loob.
Dahil puwedeng mangyari ito nang dahan-dahan.
Narito ang 5 bagay na ginagawa ng maraming believers ngayon na mukhang tama…
At baka yung una pa lang…
1. Mas Pinoprotektahan Mo Ang “Peace” Mo Kaysa Pasanin Ang Cross Mo
Ang generation natin ginawang diyos ang comfort.
At oo, may healthy boundaries na biblical.
Pero maraming believers ngayon ginagamit ang “peace” para takasan ang obedience.
Hindi nangako si Jesus ng comfort.
“If anyone would come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.”
Ang Greek phrase na “deny himself” ay:
Maraming modern Christianity ang nagtuturo kung paano gumaan ang pakiramdam.
Pero ang tunay na Christianity nagtuturo kung paano mamatay sa sarili.
Kaya maraming believers natatakot kapag naging uncomfortable ang obedience.
Pero ang biblical peace hindi kawalan ng problema.
Ang tunay na shalom ay presensya ng Diyos kahit may bagyo.
Puwede kang comfortable pero spiritually empty.
At baka kaya parang tuyong-tuyo ang spirit mo lately…
kasi umiiwas ka sa cross na ipinapapasan sa’yo ng Diyos.
2. Tinatawag Mong “Judgment” Ang Conviction Para Hindi Ka Magbago
Isa sa pinakamabisang strategy ng kaaway ngayon ay paniwalain ang tao na hate ang correction.
Kaya kapag may nagco-confront gamit ang Scripture:
Oo, kinokondena ng Bible ang hypocritical judgment.
Pero hindi nito kinokondena ang righteous discernment.
Ang tunay na pag-ibig hindi tinotolerate ang kasalanan para lang iwas conflict.
Kaya maraming tao gusto lang ng preaching na hindi sila kino-convict.
“Magpapatuloy ba tayo sa kasalanan para dumami ang grace?”
At baka habang binabasa mo ito…
alam mo nang may kino-convict ang Holy Spirit sa’yo.
Hindi ka ine-expose ng Diyos para sirain ka.
Ine-expose ka Niya para iligtas ka.
3. Mas Marami Kang Christian Content Kaysa Tunay Na Obedience
Dahil maraming believers feeling spiritually full…
Pero hindi sinusunod ang sinabi na ng Diyos.
Ang knowledge puwedeng magbigay ng illusion ng closeness with God.
“Be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.”
Pinapaniwala ang sarili na okay spiritually kahit walang pagbabago.
Dahil puwedeng alam mo ang Bible…
pero malayo na ang puso mo sa Diyos.
Hindi sapat ang pag-iyak sa worship.
At baka gusto kang tanungin ng Holy Spirit ngayon:
Kailan ka huling sumunod sa isang bagay na mahirap?
4. Nalilito Ka Na Sa Pagitan Ng Busy Ministry At Totoong Intimacy Kay God
May mga taong sobrang active sa church…
Pero tahimik na malayo sa Diyos.
Dahil magkaiba ang pagiging busy para sa Diyos at pagiging malapit sa Diyos.
“Lord, Lord, hindi ba gumawa kami ng maraming bagay sa pangalan Mo?”
Kaya puwedeng ginagamit mo ang pangalan ni Jesus publicly…
At unti-unting nagiging performance ang ministry.
Pero hindi namatay si Jesus para gumawa ng celebrities.
Namatay Siya para tubusin ang makasalanan.
Dahil kapag namatay ang secret place…
5. Mas Mahal Mo Ang Blessings Ng Diyos Kaysa Ang Diyos Mismo
Ito siguro ang pinakamalalim na sugat ng modern church.
Makikita mo iyon dahil maraming believers lumalapit lang nang todo kapag may problema.
Pero ang tunay na pagmamahal sa Diyos…
“Though He slay me, yet will I trust Him.”
Sa Hebrew, isang malalim na salita para rito ay:
At baka mahal mo ang blessings ng Diyos…
pero hindi mo talaga hinahanap ang presensya Niya.
Kaya kapag delayed ang answered prayer…
Kahit hindi ko maintindihan ang Diyos…
At baka iyon ang tanong ng article na ito:
si Jesus pa rin ba ang pipiliin mo?
Dahil ang pinakamapanganib na deception ay hindi rebelyon.
Kundi ang magmukhang spiritually alive habang malayo na pala sa puso ng Diyos.
Nagbabalik pa rin si Jesus ng mga naligaw.
Pero hinabol pa rin sila ng grace.
Dahil ang cross hindi ginawa para pagandahin lang ang masasamang tao.
Ginawa ito para buhayin ang mga patay na kaluluwa.
Darating ang araw na maraming tao mare-realize na malapit sila sa simbahan…
